metadata.description: Self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace for foretak's registry-mcp.

plugins.name: registry-mcp
plugins.description: Company data for AI agents: the United Kingdom (Companies House), Norway (Brønnøysundregistrene / brreg) and Sweden (Bolagsverket), read-only, one JSON shape. Look up by company number, organisasjonsnummer or organisationsnummer; VAT status, registered status and statutory filing deadlines with the provision each one cites. Adds the hosted registry-mcp server, no key needed.
